calibration_legend: ref_val_acc / ref_val_loss: frozen reference on val (primary metric named by ref_val_primary_name, mean task loss). student_pre_ft_val_acc / student_pre_ft_val_loss: surgery student on val after transform, before distill. student_post_distill_*: after distillation (primary metric, mean task loss, mean teacher match). gibbs_tail_prob_eps_exact_*: observed dense-softmax omitted tail mass of the top-k support (mean/std/min/max on train batches); gibbs_tail_prob_eps_calibrated_*: per-block means copied into GibbsTopKSoftmax when not using exact runtime tail mass; gibbs_tail_prob_eps_applied_*: values copied into GibbsTopKSoftmax parameters; use_exact_tail_mass: runtime q_tail via N*mean(exp) centroid partition instead of calibrated scalar.
